name: ticketing-api-skill-tools
description: Tool contracts for Ticketing As A Service IT Helpdesk operations (Public API 1.1.0)

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List IT Helpdesk tickets with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination

mode.description: Response verbosity for read output. Use summary by default; use full for full-fidelity payloads.

search.description: Full-text search across all ticket fields.

status.description: Legacy resolved-state filter. Open, Reopened, or In Progress return unresolved tickets; Resolved or Closed return resolved tickets. Use statusId for an exact workflow-state match. Custom workflows may use other labels; confirm with get_instance.

statusId.description: Exact workflow-state match. Prefer this over status when filtering to a specific state. Default labels: Open, Reopened, In Progress, Resolved, Closed. Discover custom IDs with get_instance.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag filter. Format: '{tagCategoryId}_{tagText}' (e.g. '2283653a-8d36-40eb-9a68-73eb3b331811_my tag'). Use get_tags to discover valid tagCategoryId values.

orderBy.description: Field to sort by. Known values: status, ticketId, title, requestorName, requestorEmail, assigneeName, assigneeEmail, expectedDate, priority, createdDateTime, lastInteraction. The backend may accept additional field names; the value is passed through as-is.

include.description: Set to description_HTML to return the sanitized HTML description alongside the always-present plain-text description. OpenAPI 1.1.0; retained even when select is present.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Get an IT Helpdesk ticket by id

mode.description: Response verbosity. summary returns concise ticket fields; full includes HTML description (include=description_HTML) and embedded activity details paged via GET /tickets/{ticketId}/activities.

continuationToken.description: Activity-page continuation token for the companion GET /tickets/{ticketId}/activities request when mode=full. OpenAPI 1.1.0 GET /tickets/{ticketId} itself does not page.

limit.description: Maximum number of embedded activity records to fetch when mode=full (passed to GET /tickets/{ticketId}/activities). Does not limit ticket retrieval.

include.description: Set to description_HTML to return the sanitized HTML description alongside the always-present plain-text description. OpenAPI 1.1.0; retained even when select is present.

tools.name: get_ticket_activities
tools.description: Get ticket activities with continuation token pagination, optional include=comment_HTML, and summary/full output modes

mode.description: Response verbosity for activity output. summary returns compact activity records; full returns full-fidelity activity fields.

continuationToken.description: Token from the previous response header or body to fetch the next activity page.

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return. OpenAPI 1.1.0: when omitted, all matching activities are requested.

include.description: Set to comment_HTML to include sanitized HTML in comment_HTML while comment remains plain text. OpenAPI 1.1.0.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Intake a new IT Helpdesk ticket

description.description: Plain-text ticket description. HTML characters are escaped. If both description and description_HTML are sent, description takes precedence.

description_HTML.description: Sanitized HTML ticket description. Script-capable elements, event-handler attributes, and javascript: URLs are removed. Returned in responses only when include=description_HTML.

expectedDate.description: Date only, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-04-01). Never use a datetime string when customFields is also present — the API silently discards the ticket with no error. The pattern rejects datetime strings even when the validator treats format as a non-asserting annotation.

include.description: Set to description_HTML to return the sanitized HTML description alongside the always-present plain-text description. OpenAPI 1.1.0; retained even when select is present.

tools.name: update_ticket_status
tools.description: Move a ticket to a valid next workflow state (status/workflow transition)

status.description: Target workflow-state ID. It must be one of the valid nextSteps for the ticket's current workflow state. Default labels: Open, Reopened, In Progress, Resolved, Closed. Custom workflows can use other values. Discover allowed transitions with get_instance or the ticket workflow in a full get_ticket payload.

resolution.description: Optional resolution code recorded with the status change. Verified live: the API accepts a move to Resolved/Closed WITHOUT a resolution (HTTP 200), so it is not required — but providing one records the outcome. Canonical values: fixed, cannotResolve, cancelled. Common variants (e.g. 'canceled', 'cannot resolve') are normalized by the adapter, and instances with custom workflows may define other codes, so any non-empty string is accepted. Prefer a canonical value when supplied.

tools.name: update_ticket
tools.description: Update ticket fields such as title, assignee, priority, description, and custom fields

description.description: Plain-text ticket description. HTML characters are escaped. If both description and description_HTML are sent, description takes precedence.

description_HTML.description: Sanitized HTML ticket description. Script-capable elements, event-handler attributes, and javascript: URLs are removed. Returned in responses only when include=description_HTML.

expectedDate.description: Date only, format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-04-01). Never use a datetime string when customFields is also present — the API silently discards the ticket with no error. The pattern rejects datetime strings even when the validator treats format as a non-asserting annotation.

include.description: Set to description_HTML to return the sanitized HTML description alongside the always-present plain-text description. OpenAPI 1.1.0; retained even when select is present.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket. Use isPrivate=true for an internal agent note not visible to the requestor; false (default) for a requestor-visible update.

comment.description: Plain-text comment. HTML characters are escaped. If both comment and comment_HTML are sent, comment takes precedence.

comment_HTML.description: Sanitized HTML comment. Script-capable content is removed. Returned in the created activity only when include=comment_HTML.

isPrivate.description: When true, posts an internal/private comment visible only to internal agents, not the requestor. Documented in OpenAPI 1.1.0 insertCommentRequest (default false). Verified live.

include.description: Set to comment_HTML to include sanitized HTML in comment_HTML while comment remains plain text. OpenAPI 1.1.0.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Get instance metadata including workflow definitions, assignees, and custom field details. Call before status changes on custom workflows and before using customFields.

tools.name: validation_write_closed_ticket_comment
tools.description: Find a ticket by assignee and requestor, prefer Closed status, write a formatted validation comment, and verify persistence

tools.name: find_my_unresolved_tickets
tools.description: List my unresolved IT Helpdesk tickets using status as primary signal with resolvedStatus compatibility hints

userEmail.description: Email of the user whose tickets to return. Required at call time unless the connection is configured with a default current-user email; the dispatcher throws if neither is available. If it is not supplied and no default is configured, ask the user for their email before calling.

assigneeEmail.description: Legacy alias for userEmail (assignee perspective). Prefer userEmail.

tools.name: find_my_tickets_with_unread_updates
tools.description: List my IT Helpdesk tickets that have unread updates based on unseen event counters (tickets that need attention)

userEmail.description: Email of the user whose tickets to return. Required at call time unless the connection is configured with a default current-user email; the dispatcher throws if neither is available. If it is not supplied and no default is configured, ask the user for their email before calling.

assigneeEmail.description: Legacy alias for userEmail (assignee perspective). Prefer userEmail.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: Get all tag categories and their tags. Call this before filtering tickets by tags or creating tickets with tags, to obtain valid tagCategoryId values for the filter format '{tagCategoryId}_{tagText}'.

tools.name: get_ticket_attachments
tools.description: List all attachments for a ticket (screenshots, logs, links).

tools.name: get_activity_attachments
tools.description: List attachments for a specific activity. The activityId must come from item.activityId in the add_ticket_attachment_links response — not from get_ticket_activities. Passing an activityId from get_ticket_activities returns a 500 error.

activityId.description: Must come from item.activityId in the add_ticket_attachment_links response, not from get_ticket_activities.

tools.name: add_ticket_attachment_links
tools.description: Add HTTPS link attachments to a ticket. For an internal-only attachment activity, set isPrivate=true. File binary upload (multipart) is supported by the API but not by this tool — use link attachments here.

comment.description: Plain-text comment shown with the attachments. Takes precedence over comment_HTML. OpenAPI requires comment or comment_HTML.

comment_HTML.description: Sanitized HTML comment shown with the attachments. Returned when include=comment_HTML.

src.description: HTTPS URL of the attachment. Only https:// URLs are accepted; schemes such as javascript:, file:, and data: are rejected to avoid persisting unsafe links.

isPrivate.description: When true, the attachment activity is private to internal agents. Documented in OpenAPI 1.1.0 insertAttachmentLinkRequest (required there; this tool defaults to false).

include.description: Set to comment_HTML to include sanitized HTML in comment_HTML while comment remains plain text. OpenAPI 1.1.0.
